houseFigures.list: [1] memo L144 "no row before 1910-12-06" — OWN. No logged command or script derives the earliest external_citations date: archival.py's only pointed-at query groups by repository/collection/lot with MIN(c.yr) per group (earliest printed 1913), and the memo attributes the date to nothing. My re-derivation: `SELECT MIN(d.date_iso), COUNT(*) FROM external_citations e JOIN document_dates d ON d.volume_id=e.volume_id AND d.document_id=e.document_id` → 1910-12-06 | 50173 (frus1911/d488), so the figure is right and is the rules' exact figure, not a coincidence. [2] memo L164 "11 of 695 bundled series" — OWN. No logged command counts series-facts-index.json's entries by year: lots.py reads byNaId only for nine lot NAIDs, and log lines 79–84 print legends for seven codes; the memo attributes it to nothing. My re-derivation over the installed bundle (series-facts-index.json, generated 2026-09-10): 698 byNaId entries, 11 with y0 < 1940 (1 with y1 < 1940). The 11 matches; the denominator the session's own files give is 698, so the printed 695 was copied from the rules, not counted. Neither occurrence is a coincidental match (notOne 0).
